responsibility: Provides the is_a_helper template specializations that let GCC's dyn_cast/is_a machinery recognize the symbolic-execution bit object hierarchy. It maps value_type tags to concrete classes such as symbolic_bit, bit, the various bit_expression subclasses, and bit_condition, so code in the sym-exec engine can safely discriminate and downcast value_bit and bit_expression nodes while traversing or rewriting symbolic expression trees.
